{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_vrtx_0152mrsMoNR3r7H5qG8195Qh","type":"tool_result","content":"# PWT 11.0 Database Access and Georgia Data\n\n## Database Download Links\n\nThe Penn World Table 11.0 offers multiple access formats:\n\n- **Excel format**: Available via Dataverse\n- **Stata format**: Available via Dataverse\n- **Online data access tool**: Interactive [Streamlit application](https://pwt-data-tool.streamlit.app)\n\nAll files are accessible through the DOI: 10.34894/FABVLR on the GGDC Dataverse.\n\n## Key Variables Available\n\nThe database includes several important metrics:\n\n- **RGDPNA**: Real GDP based on national-accounts growth rates\n- **CGDP variants**: Output and expenditure-side real GDP for cross-country comparisons\n- **DA (Development Accounting)**: Sources of living standards differences\n- **GA (Growth Accounting)**: Sources of economic growth analysis\n\n## Georgia-Specific Data Components\n\nTo obtain Georgia's capital stock, output, labor, and related variables, you would access through the selective data tools, which provide:\n\n- Capital detail files (investment, capital stock data by asset type)\n- Labor detail documentation (employment and educational attainment sources)\n- National Accounts data in current and constant prices\n\nThe dataset \"covers 185 countries between 1950 and 2023,\" encompassing Georgia's economic indicators across this timeframe.\n\n## Access & Attribution\n\nThe resource requires citation of Feenstra, Inklaar, and Timmer (2015) and operates under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-4-5-20251001","id":"msg_vrtx_015tGLj8KnXMmD7vxiLk15ob","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_vrtx_01EDT9wbhDFJnmXjVCuAfMUZ","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/root/imf_scraper.js","content":"const { chromium } = require('playwright');\nconst fs = require('fs');\n\nasync function scrapeIMFData() {\n  const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true });\n  const page = await browser.newPage();\n\n  try {\n    console.log('Navigating to IMF World Economic Outlook Data Mapper...');\n    await page.goto('https://www.imf.org/external/datamapper/', { waitUntil: 'networkidle', timeout: 60000 });\n\n    // Wait for the page to load completely\n    await page.waitForTimeout(3000);\n\n    console.log('Looking for search functionality...');\n\n    // Try to find and interact with the country search\n    const searchSelectors = [\n      'input[placeholder*=\"country\"]',\n      'input[placeholder*=\"Country\"]',\n      'input[type=\"search\"]',\n      'input[placeholder*=\"Search\"]',\n      'input.search-input',\n      '[data-testid=\"country-search\"]'\n    ];\n\n    let found = false;\n    for (const selector of searchSelectors) {\n      const element = await page.$(selector);\n      if (element) {\n        console.log(`Found search input with selector: ${selector}`);\n        await element.click();\n        await element.type('Georgia', { delay: 100 });\n        await page.waitForTimeout(1000);\n        found = true;\n        break;\n      }\n    }\n\n    if (!found) {\n      console.log('Could not find search input. Attempting alternative approach...');\n    }\n\n    // Look for Georgia in dropdown or list\n    const georgiaOption = await page.$('text=Georgia');\n    if (georgiaOption) {\n      console.log('Found Georgia option, clicking...');\n      await georgiaOption.click();\n      await page.waitForTimeout(2000);\n    }\n\n    // Take a screenshot to see the current state\n    await page.screenshot({ path: '/root/imf_after_search.png' });\n    console.log('Screenshot saved: imf_after_search.png');\n\n    // Look for variable selection options\n    console.log('Looking for variable options...');\n\n    // Check for Real GDP variables\n    const allText = await page.textContent('body');\n\n    if (allText.includes('Real GDP')) {\n      console.log('Found \"Real GDP\" text on page');\n    }\n\n    // Try to find and click on Real GDP options\n    const gdpConstantSelectors = [\n      'text=Real GDP (constant prices, National currency)',\n      'text=Real GDP growth',\n      'button:has-text(\"Real GDP\")'\n    ];\n\n    console.log('Attempting to select GDP variables...');\n\n    // Get all available data\n    const pageData = await page.evaluate(() => {\n      return {\n        title: document.title,\n        url: window.location.href,\n        bodyText: document.body.innerText.substring(0, 2000)\n      };\n    });\n\n    console.log('Page Title:', pageData.title);\n    console.log('Current URL:', pageData.url);\n    console.log('Page content preview:');\n    console.log(pageData.bodyText);\n\n    await page.screenshot({ path: '/root/imf_full_page.png' });\n    console.log('Full page screenshot saved: imf_full_page.png');\n\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error during scraping:', error.message);\n  } finally {\n    await browser.close();\n  }\n}\n\nscrapeIMFData();\n"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":4,"cache_creation_input_tokens":117,"cache_read_input_tokens":11633,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":117,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":1},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":"toolu_vrtx_01TqYYKsFQuktoddYYZHi8rQ","session_id":"a2da42a8-27d4-490c-9a26-22ece3f26ecb","uuid":"b87d388d-ee06-4f10-9819-9020d417163d"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-4-5-20251001","id":"msg_vrtx_01H6Q9cG9Vt6iUfjU271F3o9","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_vrtx_01DW6Bqe5qJNDcAE8vTAobAJ","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/root/imf_scraper.js","content":"const { chromium } = require('playwright');\nconst fs = require('fs');\n\nasync function scrapeIMFData() {\n  const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true });\n  const page = await browser.newPage();\n\n  try {\n    console.log('Navigating to IMF World Economic Outlook Data Mapper...');\n    // Use load instead of networkidle due to heavy JavaScript\n    await page.goto('https://www.imf.org/external/datamapper/', { waitUntil: 'load', timeout: 90000 });\n\n    console.log('Page loaded, waiting for dynamic content...');\n    await page.waitForTimeout(5000);\n\n    // Get page information\n    const pageInfo = await page.evaluate(() => {\n      return {\n        title: document.title,\n        url: window.location.href,\n        hasCountrySearch: !!document.querySelector('[placeholder*=\"country\"], [placeholder*=\"Country\"], input[type=\"search\"]')\n      };\n    });\n\n    console.log('Page loaded successfully');\n    console.log('Title:', pageInfo.title);\n    console.log('Has country search:', pageInfo.hasCountrySearch);\n\n    // Take a screenshot to see the current state\n    await page.screenshot({ path: '/root/imf_loaded.png' });\n    console.log('Screenshot saved: imf_loaded.png');\n\n    // Try multiple approaches to find search input\n    console.log('Attempting to find and use search functionality...');\n\n    // Approach 1: Direct input search\n    const inputs = await page.locator('input').all();\n    console.log(`Found ${inputs.length} input elements on the page`);\n\n    for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(5, inputs.length); i++) {\n      const placeholder = await inputs[i].getAttribute('placeholder');\n      const type = await inputs[i].getAttribute('type');\n      console.log(`Input ${i}: type=${type}, placeholder=${placeholder}`);\n    }\n\n    // Try clicking on any visible search or country selection elements\n    const allButtons = await page.locator('button').all();\n    console.log(`Found ${allButtons.length} buttons on the page`);\n\n    // Look for elements containing \"country\" or \"select\"\n    const countryElements = await page.locator('text=/country|Country|select|Select/i').all();\n    console.log(`Found ${countryElements.length} country/select related elements`);\n\n    // Try a different approach - look at the page structure\n    const pageStructure = await page.evaluate(() => {\n      const elements = [];\n      document.querySelectorAll('*').forEach(el => {\n        if (el.textContent && (el.textContent.includes('Country') || el.textContent.includes('country'))) {\n          elements.push({\n            tag: el.tagName,\n            text: el.textContent.substring(0, 50),\n            classes: el.className\n          });\n        }\n      });\n      return elements.slice(0, 10);\n    });\n\n    console.log('Page structure with Country references:');\n    console.log(JSON.stringify(pageStructure, null, 2));\n\n    // Try to find the main data area\n    const mainContent = await page.evaluate(() => {\n      const text = document.body.innerText.substring(0, 3000);\n      return text;\n    });\n\n    console.log('Page content preview:');\n    console.log(mainContent);\n\n    // Save HTML for inspection\n    const html = await page.content();\n    fs.writeFileSync('/root/imf_page.html', html);\n    console.log('Full HTML saved to imf_page.html');\n\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error during scraping:', error.message);\n    console.error('Error stack:', error.stack);\n  } finally {\n    await browser.close();\n  }\n}\n\nscrapeIMFData();\n"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":3,"cache_creation_input_tokens":273,"cache_read_input_tokens":14972,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":273,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":1},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":"toolu_vrtx_01TqYYKsFQuktoddYYZHi8rQ","session_id":"a2da42a8-27d4-490c-9a26-22ece3f26ecb","uuid":"e6b69e35-3252-4fd8-a75c-c2dd8e2a6a63"}

Fetching Real GDP Growth Rate for Georgia...');\n    await page.goto('https://www.imf.org/external/datamapper/NGDP_RPCH@WEO', {\n      waitUntil: 'load',\n      timeout: 60000\n    });\n    await page.waitForTimeout(3000);\n\n    // Search for Georgia\n    console.log('   Searching for Georgia...');\n    const searchInput = await page.locator('input[placeholder=\"Search\"]').first();\n    if (searchInput) {\n      await searchInput.click();\n      await searchInput.fill('Georgia');\n      await page.waitForTimeout(2000);\n\n      const georgiaOption = await Highcharts\n    const growthData = await page.evaluate(() => {\n      const result = {\n        variable: 'Real GDP Growth Rate',\n        country: 'Georgia',\n        data: []\n      };\n\n      // Try to get data from Highcharts instance\n      if (window.Highcharts && window.Highcharts.charts) {\n        for (let chart of window.Highcharts.charts) {\n          if (chart && chart.series) {\n       value: point.y\n                }));\n              }\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      }\n\n      // If Highcharts didn't work, try looking at SVG text\n      if (result.data.length lines.slice(0, 100)\n        };\n      }\n\n      return result;\n    });\n\n    console.log('   Growth Rate Data extracted:');\n    console.log(`   Found ${growthData.data.length} data points`);\n    if (growthData.data.length > 0) {\n      console.log('   Sample data:', growthData.data.slice(0, 5));\n    }\n\n    // Now navigate to Real GDP level (constant prices)\n    console.log('\\n2. Fetching Real GDP Level (constant prices) for Georgia...');\n\n    // The variable code for Real GDP in constant prices is typically NGDP_R or similar\n    const realGDPUrls = [\n      'https://www.imf.org/external/datamapper/NGDP_R@WEO',\n      'https://www.imf.org/external/datamapper/NGDP@WEO',\n      'https://www.imf.org/external/datamapper/NGDPD@WEO'\n    ];\n\n    let levelData = { variable: 'Real GDP Level', country: 'Georgia', data: [] };\n\n    for (const url of realGDPUrls) {\n      console.log(`   Trying URL: ${url.split('/').pop()}`);\n      try {\n        await page.waitForTimeout(2000);\n          }\n        }\n\n        // Extract data\n        levelData = await page.evaluate(() => {\n          const result = {\n            variable: 'Real GDP Level',\n            country: 'Georgia',\n            data: []\n          };\n\n          if (window.Highcharts && window.Highcharts.charts) {\n            for (let chart of window.Highcharts.charts) {\n              if (chart && chart.series) {\n                for (let series of chart.series) {\n                  if (series.data) {\n                    result.data = series.data.map(point => ({\n                      year: point.category || point.x,\n                      value: point.y\n                    }));\n                  }\n                }\n              }\n            }\n          }\n\n          return result;\n        });\n\n        if (levelData.data.length > 0) {\n          console.log(`   Found data with ${levelData.data.length} points`);\n          break;\n        }\n      } catch (err) {\n        console.log(`   Failed with error: ${err.message.substring(0, 50)}`);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Compile all data for 2000-2027\n    console.log('\\n\\n3. COMPILING DATA FOR 2000-2027...\\n');\n\n    const startYear = 2000;\n    const endYear = 2027;\n    const compiledData = [];\n\n    // Filter growth data for 2000-2027\n    const growthByYear = {};\n    if (growthData.data && growthData.data.length > 0) {\n      growthData.data.forEach(item => {\n        if (item.year && item.value !== null && item.value !== undefined) {\n          const year = parseInt(item.year);\n          if (year >= startYear && year <= endYear) {\n            growthByYear[year] = item.value;\n          }\n        }\n      });\n    }\n\n    // Filter level data for 2000-2027\n    const levelByYear = {};\n    if (levelData.data && levelData.data.length > 0) {\n      levelData.data.forEach(item => {\n        if (item.year && item.value !== null && item.value !== undefined) {\n          const year = parseInt(item.year);\n          if (year >= startYear && year <= endYear) {\n            levelByYear[year] = item.value;\n          }\n        }\n      });\n    }\n\n    // Combine data\n    for (let year = startYear; year <= endYear; year++) {\n      compiledData.push({\n        year: year,\n        real_gdp_level: levelByYear[year] || null,\n        real_gdp_growth_rate: growthByYear[year] || null\n      });\n    }\n\n    // Output in structured format\n    console.log('GEORGIA ECONOMIC DATA (2000-2027)');\n    console.log('==================================\\n');\n    console.log('Year\\tReal GDP Level\\tReal GDP Growth Rate (%)');\n    console.log('---\\t---------------\\t------------------------');\n\n    compiledData.forEach(item => {\n      const level = item.real_gdp_level !== null ? item.real_gdp_level.toFixed(2) : 'N/A';\n      const growth = item.real_gdp_growth_rate !== null ? item.real_gdp_growth_rate.toFixed(2) : 'N/A';\n      console.log(`${item.year}\\t${level}\\t\\t${growth}`);\n    });\n\n    // Save to JSON file\n    const outputData = {\n      country: 'Georgia',\n      dataset: 'IMF World Economic Outlook (October 2025)',\n      yearRange: { start: startYear, end: endYear },\n      data: compiledData,\n      generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      sourceUrl: 'https://www.imf.org/external/datamapper/'\n    };\n\n    fs.writeFileSync('/root/georgia_gdp_data.json', JSON.stringify(outputData, null, 2));\n    console.log('\\n\\nData saved to: georgia_gdp_data.json');\n\n    // Also save as CSV\n    let csvContent = 'Year,Real GDP Level,Real GDP Growth Rate (%)\\n';\n    compiledData.forEach(item => {\n      const level = item.real_gdp_level !== null ?
